rationale: The stock has gapped up ~7% with no identifiable news catalyst and is consolidating in a very tight band near the session high ($5.92), but the last four 5-minute candles show dramatically collapsing volume (1,300–3,000 shares) suggesting the move is stalling rather than building continuation pressure. The 5-minute ATR of $0.02 is effectively equal to the bid-ask spread, meaning any directional trade immediately faces a full spread cost relative to the expected move, making a favorable risk/reward structure nearly impossible to construct in either direction.
